title: The damsel challenge
description: In the Sun Room, a countdown reads DAMSEL CHALLENGE BEGINS IN 3... while the Damsel walks about among the traps. A point is counted each second as the arrow traps shoot her and the spear traps stab; a lit bomb drops from the ceiling onto the player, who stands still, and kills him at 10 points. FINISHED! and YOU SET A NEW RECORD! follow.
